root_cause.text: The dmirror_fops_release() function frees the dmirror struct without first migrating device private pages back to system memory, leaving those pages with a dangling pointer to the freed structure, causing use-after-free in the fault handler.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "When dmirror_fops_release() is called it frees the dmirror struct but doesn't migrate device private pages back to system memory first. This leaves those pages with a dangling zone_device_data pointer to the freed dmirror. If a subsequent fault occurs on those pages (eg. during coredump) the dmirror_devmem_fault() callback dereferences the stale pointer causing a kernel panic." The patch fixes this by calling dmirror_device_evict_chunk() for each devmem chunk in dmirror_fops_release() before freeing the dmirror.
